Use this procedure for each Continual-ARC instance; task programs persist by id, but treat each conversation as self-contained.

def transform(grid):
    # Infer the two-color palette and map its background/foreground consistently.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    foreground = next((v for v in counts if v != background), background)
    # Most demonstrated palette pairs normalize to background=0 and foreground=background.
    return [[0 if v == background else background for v in row] for row in grid]
